title: Creating a macro to wake you up and to avoid missing price swings (I only know how to make it work on android phones)
author: finnholland
selftext: There is an app that allows you to create a macro that will trigger a alarm sound when receiving a tradingview notification, I found the workflow chatting with AI, havent seen anyone talking about it and I was wondering if I create a youtube channel to share this, would anyone find it useful (If so I think I am going to create it)
